domains.name: account-keys
domains.notes: Account entropy pool parsing, SVR key derivation, backup key derivation, backup ID derivation, and PIN access key vectors.

domains.name: svr-key
domains.notes: SVR key derivation is covered as part of the account-keys vector batch.

domains.name: backup-id
domains.notes: Backup key and backup ID derivations are covered as part of the account-keys vector batch.

domains.name: account-backup-derivations
domains.notes: Backup key, backup ID, local metadata key, media key, thumbnail key, and backup forward-secrecy derivation formulas are owned by accountkeys; committed fixtures currently vector-lock the root backup key and backup ID.

domains.name: username-links
domains.notes: Username-link entropy, IV, ciphertext, HMAC, and upstream decrypted username.

domains.name: username-reserve-hash
domains.notes: Username reservation hash vectors generated from upstream rust/usernames Username::hash; proof generation remains deferred.

domains.name: username-hash-proof
domains.reason: The poksho primitive is available, but username-specific proof generation and verification are not yet ported.
domains.next_upstream_input: Upstream username proof vectors and the username-specific statement/transcript implementation.

domains.name: backup-manifest
domains.reason: Backup manifest serialization and validation live in upstream message-backup/app storage code, not this client-protocol module.
domains.next_upstream_input: Stable upstream backup manifest fixtures and a selected Go package boundary for message backup metadata.

domains.name: message-backup
domains.reason: Message-backup service/storage formats are outside this client-protocol module; only backup key and backup ID derivations are vector-backed here.
domains.next_upstream_input: Stable upstream message-backup export/import fixtures and storage-format schemas.

domains.name: svr-svrb-proof
domains.reason: SVR key derivation is vector-backed here; SVR/SVRB service proof semantics require the later proof-system package boundary.
domains.next_upstream_input: Upstream SVR/SVRB proof fixtures plus the zkcredential/poksho primitives needed to verify them.

domains.name: key-transparency
domains.reason: Key-transparency checkpoint and search proof verification require upstream transparency fixtures and a proof-system boundary outside the protocol core.
domains.next_upstream_input: Stable upstream key-transparency checkpoint/search proof vectors and the hash/proof primitives needed to consume them.

domains.name: poksho
domains.notes: Both SHO variants, scalar/point conversions, Schnorr signatures and multi-equation proofs at v0.102.2; bidirectional live Rust interoperability. Does not implement zkgroup, zkcredential, or username proofs.

domains.name: noise
domains.notes: Noise_NK_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256 and Noise_NKhfs_25519+Kyber1024_ChaChaPoly_SHA256 (ML-KEM-1024) as rust/attest drives them on snow 0.10.0, both roles, with ClientConnection's transport chunking; bidirectional live Rust interoperability. SGX attestation and the CDSI client state are separate.

domains.name: zkgroup-crypto
domains.notes: UID/profile-key attributes, encryption, commitments, timestamps and reversible Ristretto maps at v0.102.2. Legacy credential proofs are covered separately in zkgroup-credentials; generic zkcredential is covered separately; group API/shim remains deferred.

domains.name: zkgroup-credentials
domains.notes: Legacy KVAC key layouts, profile and receipt requests, blinded issuance, unblinding, request/issuance/presentation proofs and signatures at v0.102.2. Go rejects trailing bytes that the pinned Rust deserialize_in_place accepts. Generic zkcredential is covered separately; group API/shim remains deferred.

domains.name: zkcredential
domains.notes: Generic attributes, standard/legacy credentials, clear and blind issuance, mixed presentations and batch endorsements at v0.102.2. 52 complete Rust flows and fresh live interoperability; application-specific request proofs and Signal API wrappers remain separate.
